Faster, stricter, and much closer to the spec.

## Highlights
- **About 2× faster parsing and 3× faster generation**, with far fewer allocations.
- **Spec-checked in CI**: all 563 official kdl-org v1/v2 cases and 118 kdl-rs cases run on every push.
- **Generated KDL always parses back**, verified across the whole official corpus and by fuzzing.
- **Better errors**: positions point at the offending token, as in kdl-rs, and CRLF files get correct line numbers.

## Fixes
- Numbers directly before `}`, `{`, `;` or a comment now parse. `n {x 1}` used to fail.
- v2: a typed argument after another argument parses, as in `node 1 (u8)2`.
- A failing reader is reported instead of silently yielding an empty document.
- `UnmarshalWithOptions` honours all its options.
- Marshal:
  - `MarshalText` output is no longer truncated.
  - Structs inside `interface{}` no longer panic.
  - Same-named types no longer collide.
- Accepted now:
  - literal U+FFFD
  - signed hex/octal/binary
- Quoted type annotations are decoded: `("u8")` equals `(u8)`.

## Heads-up
- **Stricter parsing**: these are now rejected:
  - `node { a b= }`
  - `"\u{zz}"`
  - v1 `x=bad`
  - v2 values not separated by whitespace, including backtick expressions such as `` `a``b` ``
- **Error positions changed**: they now mark the start of the offending token, and an off-by-one in columns after line 1 is fixed.
- **Go 1.22+** is required.

Full details: #29 · https://github.com/njreid/gokdl2/compare/v0.6.1...v0.7.0
